data.title: 2H 2020 Transparency Report Statistics
data.content:
There was a total of 184 government requests for communication data on our services, which was not significantly different from the first half of 2020 (201 requests). Kakao has not provided communication data since the first half of 2013. 
 In response to requests for data on the communication-restricting measures of Daum services, a thorough review based on legal standards is conducted and only partial data pertaining to the standards is provided. In the case of Kakao’s services, we do not provide any data on communication-restricting measures. 
 The number of requests for communication data related to Daum services decreased by 31.2% compared to the first half of 2020, and the number of accounts processed decreased by 28.2%. In the case of Kakao’s services, the numbers of requests and accounts processed have both decreased by 25.3% and 24.9% respectively, in comparison to those of the first half of 2020. 
 The numbers of requests based on search and seizure warrants for Daum and Kakao services have decreased by 22.6% and 10.2% respectively, compared to the first half of 2020. Kakao strives to provide only the minimum necessary information to meet the requirements. 
 Meanwhile, the number of accounts processed in response to requests based on search and seizure warrants for Daum services increased to a notably high 53,980 accounts. This was due to the fact that 45,389 accounts pertained to a specific case of law violation. Excluding this case, the number of processed accounts would amount to 8,591 accounts, which is not significantly different from the first half of 2020 (7,742 accounts).
